info.name: Class Management API — MVP-7 (Admin & Moderation)
info.description: End-to-end MVP-7 flows: in-app notifications (class approve → student notified), reports & moderation (submit → idempotent → admin ban), live system-settings limits, admin dashboard / audit log / announcements, and production hardening (login lockout + health). Cookie-based auth via Postman's cookie jar; folders re-login to switch actor. Run folders 0→5 top-to-bottom against a freshly-seeded local API. Reuse the 'Class Management — Local' environment.
